designationHistory.name: Cape Romain Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Cape Romain Migratory Bird Refuge was established under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act to protect habitat for waterfowl, shorebirds and seabirds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cape Romain National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
USFWS, 508 Cape Romain National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 169393): "Established in 1932 as a migratory bird refuge"; "Date Established: 1932"
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7316, Enlarging Cape Romain Migratory Bird Refuge (Mar. 13, 1936)

review.note: 1932 (CCP). EO 7316 (Mar. 13, 1936) confirms it was "established under the said Migratory Bird Conservation Act." Exact date not found.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cape Romain 1800s Lighthouses Established in 1932 as a migratory bird refuge, the refuge's original objectives were to conserve in public ownership habitat for waterfowl, shorebirds and seabirds, and resident species.
